prepare_handoff.name: prepare_handoff
prepare_handoff.description: Revalidate the selected website bag and record/retrieve its immutable planning handoff. Requires browser-approved local credential. No source bytes or target writes. This tool is part of plugin `HeadStart`.

search_components.name: search_components
search_components.description: Search the real public catalog. Exact constraints stay enforced; no credentials sent. This tool is part of plugin `HeadStart`.

get_selected_bag.name: get_selected_bag
get_selected_bag.description: Automatically retrieve the most recently prepared website bag for the verified account. Anonymous browser collections are not synced. This tool is part of plugin `HeadStart`.
